text:
vivian: Heads-up — onboarding sample-app's rerank flow failed in CI. Batcher assert: expected (4,1536) got (4,768). Curious thing: node SDK response had field `vector` while python had `embedding` — combined with differing aliases dims, aggregator blew up.

noah: wait `vector` vs `embedding`? that's a schema divergence. which model aliases + SDK versions?

vivian: node-sdk@0.13 calling alias open-embed-lite -> payload: {
  "data": [{ "id": "u1", "vector": [/* 768 floats */] }, ...]
}
python-sdk@0.14 calling open-embed-pro -> payload: {
  "data": [{ "id": "u1", "embedding": [/*1536 floats*/] }, ...]
}
error surfaced in rerank/collector.py: line 62 when doing shape matrix stack.

tara: two separate issues: 1) SDK alias defaults differ across languages; 2) response key name mismatch causing our shared helper to try to read both keys and sometimes pick the wrong one (we do fallback logic but it's brittle).

ci-bot: CI: samples/rerank-onboard-e2e #512 failed — see job logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/512 (sanitized).

noah: Possible root cause: older node SDK mapper used `vector` historically; newer pipeline standardized on `embedding` but node package.json wasn't bumped. Also alias open-embed-lite is a compressed 768-dim variant. So both key and dim mismatches.

vivian: repro curl (sanitized):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"input":["foo","bar"],"model":"open-embed-lite"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
```
Response: `{"data":[{"id":"1","vector":[...768 floats...]}, ...]}`

jordan: another wrinkle: when ephemeral tokens refresh, node-sdk retried and emitted two responses for the same request id when idempotency-key wasn't passed from the consumer. Our aggregator uses arrival order+id to merge; duplicate arrivals with slightly different key names caused last-write-wins and scrambled batch ordering.

leo: short-term mitigation: in sharedlib `embed_adapter.normalize_response(resp)` — look for `embedding` then `vector` then `vec`; convert to a uniform `embedding` array and assert dim equals expected for the chosen alias. If mismatch, raise a descriptive error: "Embedding shape mismatch: expected X got Y from alias Z. Check SDK alias parity."

noah: agreed. long-term: enforce a canonical response contract server-side and add a breaking-change bump notice for older SDKs. Also add SDK unit tests that call every alias once and assert (field_name == 'embedding') && (dim matches catalog[alias]).

ci-bot: created ticket samples/issues/964 for sample-app fix and infra/issues/246 for idempotency + aggregator dedupe.

vivian: i've pushed a tiny fix to samples/onboard/normalize-vec: add fallback and early assert so demos don't hang. PR: https://github.com/redwood/sample-apps/pull/1210 (wip).

jordan: i'll pick up idempotency-key enforcement on retry logic — will ensure token-refresh path replays original headers, including x-idempotency-key.

leo: docs ask: add a quick debug snippet to onboarding: `if len(embedding) not in (768,1536): raise ValueError(...)` and a note about alias selection. keep it terse.

noah: created CI job to run node+py SDK callers against all embed aliases and assert field name + dim consistency. If mismatch, fail build and open auto-issue with the observed shapes.

vivian: thanks all — small DX fixes but high ROI. I'll add the sanitized failing payload and the CI link to the PR description. :thumbsup:
